integrity: The mathematical input from arXiv:2608.13528v1 was checked at Theorem 1 and Clifford Corollary 3, including Eqs. (28)-(35). The graph extension is proved independently from support propagation and Pauli counting. MSC 81P68 is the sole MSC classification shown by scientific index record Pith:QU3PCQKT; the arXiv record itself is filed under quant-ph.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to fourth-moment approximation of the Clifford Haar measure by layered edge-local two-qubit circuits. It does not claim tight construction depth on general graphs, does not cover measurement/feed-forward or interactions outside the graph, and for errors at least \(3/4\) retains only the exact ball-volume inequality.
title: Graph-diameter lower bounds for ambient Clifford fourth-moment designs
